macro_bullets: Deadly attacks on Saudi airports disrupt aviation and lift crude as Houthis vow retaliation and Saudi Arabia strikes Yemen's capital.
Memory and semiconductor stocks sell off hard on reports China's CXMT flagged a denser DRAM design breakthrough.
Meta rallies a second day on a well-received new AI model family, reinforcing the AI-capex theme the IMF says is propping up global growth.
Big-bank and insurer earnings open mixed, with Citi topping estimates, Wells Fargo falling short on net interest income, and UnitedHealth hiking its outlook.
Hot inflation expectations are reviving rate-hike concerns ahead of key U.S. inflation data.
internals_narrative: Defensive and cyclical-income groups led with Consumer Staples +1.3%, Energy +1.1% and Real Estate +1.0%, while Technology -0.4%, Semiconductors -1.9%, Robotics & Hardware -4.3% and Memory -5.1% lagged. Top gainers were MDT +3.9%, META +3.4% and STZ +3.1%, against losers OUST -6.6%, SNDK -6.0%, USAR -5.9% and MU -3.9%.

ticker_notes.MDT: Medtronic topped gainers amid reports on growth in the mHealth and bioelectronic medicine device markets.
ticker_notes.META: Meta rose for a second straight day as its new AI model family impressed.
ticker_notes.STZ: Constellation Brands returned to the M&A fray amid a stagnant U.S. beer market.
ticker_notes.ACN: Accenture acquired Sagacity to expand AI-driven customer intelligence across its UK and Ireland operations.
ticker_notes.VZ: Bernstein cut Verizon's price target on SpaceX's Starlink mobile push.
ticker_notes.BSX: Boston Scientific was cited among advancers in the growing closed-loop neurostimulation device market.
ticker_notes.COP: ConocoPhillips advanced as elevated crude prices followed the Saudi airport attacks.
ticker_notes.OUST: Ouster slid after reporting Q2 2026 results.
ticker_notes.SNDK: SanDisk dropped in the memory selloff on China's DRAM progress, ahead of its Oct. 29 earnings.
ticker_notes.USAR: USA Rare Earth fell about 6% with milestone-based government funding still ahead of it.
ticker_notes.DRAM: Memory names slid as China's CXMT flagged a denser chip design.
ticker_notes.MU: Micron fell as China's CXMT and Broadcom's CEO rattled chip stocks.
ticker_notes.CMG: Chipotle dropped after Starbucks confirmed it will not acquire the company.
ticker_notes.RKLB: Rocket Lab slipped as SpaceX's direct-to-cell threat hit space names, with AST SpaceMobile down 9%.
ticker_notes.AIG: AIG drew price-target cuts from Wells Fargo and KBW despite maintained ratings.
ticker_notes.APD: Barclays initiated Air Products at Overweight with a $353 price target.
ticker_notes.AMT: Bernstein called SpaceX's spectrum deal a catalyst for tower stocks.
ticker_notes.AMD: Fermi soared 16% as AMD backed its 222 MW Texas AI lease.
ticker_notes.AEP: American Electric Power secured up to $3.26 billion in federal funding to modernize the Texas grid.
